verdict.rationale: Twilio Video is a developer video API/SDK, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer natural-language operation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no natural-language command interface. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes are LLM-readable documentation, a developer building block rather than natural-language control of the product. Real-time transcription is a call feature, not a way to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
